# Sample Restaurant v0.06

Restaurant v0.06 upgrades the menu into a polished HTML-first, conversion-ready, MCP-action-ready restaurant preview.

## Routes
- /menu polished HTML-first menu
- /menu?variant=dark A/B dark preview
- /menu.json structured menu with specials and season badges
- /registry.json source registry for Mobile Terminal and MCP dry runs
- /mcp/actions preview-only action catalog
- /mcp/actions/update-seasonal-menu dry-run action detail
- /schema.json Restaurant/Menu/MenuSection/MenuItem/Offer/Review/Article concepts

## Safety
Preview-only. No production routes, custom domains, account IDs, secrets, or deployment.confirmed changes. MCP actions require confirmation and keep production_deploy false.
